item.title: DHARMMA Strategic Framework
item.description:
The Challenge

A multi-institutional research network needed a unified vision to guide its collaborative efforts. We were brought in to design and facilitate a strategic planning process that could establish clear short-term (1-2 year) and long-term (3-7 year) goals while anticipating future challenges and opportunities.

Our Approach

We guided the network through our DHARMMA strategic planning framework, a multi-stage process designed to build consensus and create actionable roadmaps. The framework’s name outlines the key steps of our engagement:
